### Fixed
- **A fresh install of the serving slice comes back Ready: `components.kserve-runtime-configs.driftDetection` ignores the configs' `/spec`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#508). Once Helm has applied the well-known `LLMInferenceServiceConfig`s, KServe writes the fields its API types default (`spec.model.uri`, a port's `protocol` and `appProtocol`, an empty `resources`, a backendRef's `group`) into `kserve-config-llm-scheduler` and `-latency-predictor`; helm-controller compared them with the chart's manifest, corrected them on every reconcile and left the release `Ready=Unknown`, so a first install (`agentlab up`, a new slice through cluster-manager) never finished. A config that is gone is still re-created on the next reconcile. `make verify-serving-slice` asserts the rule.
